escapes.plausible_wrong_implementation: Keep the old certificate after later material writes and treat CI success on the new head as sufficient without a fresh freeze and result-only handoff.

literal_case.procedure: Compare the stale certificate material identity with the fresh PR head, classify the material delta, rerun final exact-head gates and refreeze the current material candidate.
literal_case.observed: The stale certificate was rejected, the new material candidate is 7080a2c1f38b44cc3a9c58f597fa64ab6f495fbf, and exact-head CI run 34411339129 is terminal green before new certificate publication.

sibling_cases.evidence: The recovery rule classifies any source/test/config/docs write after certification as material drift requiring refreeze.
The terminal guard requires the result-only child parent to equal the frozen material head and rejects lineage drift.

prevention_change.evidence: Post-write-refreeze is mandatory after material writes; auditor recovery scope is a lower bound and cannot be downgraded.

detection_change.evidence: Fresh head/parent/path comparison plus exact-head CI and result-only allowlist checks close the stale-handoff class.
